import ctypes
import os

def load_gsl_libraries():
    # Load the required GSL libraries in the correct order
    libgslcblas = ctypes.CDLL("/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgslcblas.so", mode=ctypes.RTLD_GLOBAL)
    libgsl = ctypes.CDLL("/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgsl.so")
    return libgsl

def define_gsl_cdf_functions(libgsl):
    # Define the gsl_cdf_exponential_P function
    libgsl.gsl_cdf_exponential_P.argtypes = [ctypes.c_double, ctypes.c_double]
    libgsl.gsl_cdf_exponential_P.restype = ctypes.c_double

    # Define the gsl_cdf_exponential_Q function
    libgsl.gsl_cdf_exponential_Q.argtypes = [ctypes.c_double, ctypes.c_double]
    libgsl.gsl_cdf_exponential_Q.restype = ctypes.c_double

def gsl_cdf_exponential(x, mu):
    # Load the GSL library
    libgsl = load_gsl_libraries()

    # Define the CDF functions
    define_gsl_cdf_functions(libgsl)

    # Call the C functions
    P = libgsl.gsl_cdf_exponential_P(x, mu)
    Q = libgsl.gsl_cdf_exponential_Q(x, mu)

    return P, Q

def assert_test():
    # Test cases for the gsl_cdf_exponential function

    # Test case 1: x = 0, mu = 1
    P, Q = gsl_cdf_exponential(0.0, 1.0)
    assert abs(P - 0.0) < 1e-9, f"Test case 1 failed: P = {P}"
    assert abs(Q - 1.0) < 1e-9, f"Test case 1 failed: Q = {Q}"

    # Test case 2: x = 1, mu = 1
    P, Q = gsl_cdf_exponential(1.0, 1.0)
    assert abs(P - (1 - 1 / 2.718281828459045)) < 1e-9, f"Test case 2 failed: P = {P}"
    assert abs(Q - 1 / 2.718281828459045) < 1e-9, f"Test case 2 failed: Q = {Q}"

    # Test case 3: x = -1, mu = 1 (edge case)
    P, Q = gsl_cdf_exponential(-1.0, 1.0)
    assert abs(P - 0.0) < 1e-9, f"Test case 3 failed: P = {P}"
    assert abs(Q - 1.0) < 1e-9, f"Test case 3 failed: Q = {Q}"

    # Test case 4: x = 2, mu = 2
    P, Q = gsl_cdf_exponential(2.0, 2.0)
    assert abs(P - (1 - 1 / 2.718281828459045 ** (2 / 2))) < 1e-9, f"Test case 4 failed: P = {P}"
    assert abs(Q - 1 / 2.718281828459045 ** (2 / 2)) < 1e-9, f"Test case 4 failed: Q = {Q}"

    print("All test cases passed!")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    assert_test()
